report.title: Mistral-Small-4-119B-2603 IQ3 two-RTX-3090 context and review evaluation
report.scope: Mistral IQ3 capacity, throughput, long-context review reliability, and independently supervised review quality. This is not a direct Mistral-versus-Qwen SWE-bench coding comparison.

environment.full_residency_requirement: 37/37 layers on GPU, no CPU weight offload

phase2.method: Fresh server per point; cold cache-independent prompt near context limit; warmup; 128 forced completion tokens; server timing fields.

findings.reason: 128k retains about 49 decode tok/s and has a roughly 206-208 second cold prefill; 192k and 256k require 7-13 minutes of cold prefill.

phase3.method: 128k allocation, approximately 120k-token prompt, reasoning_effort=high, natural EOS, full text capture.

mistral_xxs.temperature_mitigation: No usable mitigation observed: seed 42 prematurely stopped at 0.8 and 0.6, while a comparable raw 0.7 diagnostic stopped mid-[THINK] without an answer.

phase3.finding: IQ3_S is the dependable 128k natural-EOS response quant in this sample; IQ3_XXS has a persistent premature-EOS failure mode.

phase4.method: Static baseline: four blind reviews of real unresolved Qwen SWE-bench patches. Mistral reviewers received a fixed adversarial prompt at 32k context, seed 1337, temperature 0.8, and reasoning_effort=high. Terra compared answers to a fixed gold-derived key hidden from the models.
phase4.qwen_reviewer_output: Excluded from scoring because Qwen is a SWE comparison target and supplied the candidate patches.
phase4.finding: IQ3_S was modestly better in the constrained static baseline. The corrected direct agentic follow-up found no valid objection across all four preregistered repository-aware cases.

agentic_follow_up.invalidated_attempts: The earlier mini-SWE-agent trajectories used a marker-only command and could not capture a review file from stdout, so they are excluded from reviewer-quality scoring.
agentic_follow_up.method: Direct Docker loop over real SWE-bench base repositories with read-only candidate patch mount, bash(command), submit_review(text), normal OpenAI tool history, tool-call smoke test, 128k context, reasoning_effort=high, temperature=0.7, and a 30-step hard budget.
agentic_follow_up.sphinx: Submitted at step 23 but reviewed the base behavior rather than the candidate patch. Terra scored 0/2 hidden objections and no additional valid objection.
agentic_follow_up.seaborn: Submitted at step 30. Terra scored 0/2 hidden objections and no additional valid objection.
agentic_follow_up.sympy: Reached the 30-step limit without calling submit_review, yielding 0/2 hidden objections.
agentic_follow_up.django: Submitted at step 28. Terra scored 0/1 hidden objection and no additional valid objection.
agentic_follow_up.scoring: The direct agentic screen is 0/7 hidden objections with 3/4 submitted reviews. Review claims were also checked for additional repository-supported objections; none were valid.

verdict.residency_and_throughput: GO: both quants fully resident through 256k with usable decode throughput.
verdict.long_context_planning: Conditional pilot for IQ3_S only. It passed the 128k reliability check, but planning quality was not directly benchmarked.
verdict.autonomous_reviewer: NO-GO for both quants. The constrained static scores were 1.5/7 for IQ3_XXS and 2.0/7 for IQ3_S; the corrected IQ3_S agentic screen scored 0/7 with 3/4 submissions.
verdict.autonomous_meta_reviewer: NO-GO for both quants because of the static quality baseline and the corrected agentic result.
verdict.iq3_xxs_at_128k: NO-GO because 3/8 runs produced no answer through premature EOS.
verdict.operational_default: Use IQ3_S at 128k for non-authoritative long-context assistance with independent verification; use 192k or 256k only when their cold-prefill latency is acceptable.

limitations: Each Phase 2 point is one timed run, not a confidence interval.
Phase 3 has 8 IQ3_XXS and 3 IQ3_S samples.
The static and corrected agentic Phase 4 screens each have four cases and seven hidden objections.
Gold-derived objections are not exhaustive, although the agentic reviews were also checked for additional repository-supported objections and none were valid.
No direct Mistral-versus-Qwen SWE-bench resolution-rate comparison was run.
No 256k natural-EOS review reliability run was performed.
